title: Deep review of INVENTORY.md surfaced and fixed a dropped-statistic bug and an inventory-parser bug; found one unfixed latent multiplicity design flaw

claims.text: fig03_unit_census.py computed panel g's firing-rate-vs-omission-effect correlation (panel_stim_omission_correlation, with shuffle null) and drew/saved the figure into figS20, but the Result it returned was never appended to the `stats` list passed to figstats.write() -- the figure shipped with an implied statistical claim and zero receipt behind it in fig03_stats.md/csv. Fixed by appending corr_res to stats before write().
claims.receipt: grep confirmed 'fig03_correlation' family absent from fig03_stats.csv before the fix; after adding stats.append(corr_res) and re-running fig03_unit_census.py, 'Family: fig03_correlation' now present with 1 test (Spearman r=-0.010, p=0.3676, n=8592)

claims.text: build_inventory.py's regex required the literal word 'tests' (plural), so every family with exactly 1 test ('1 test corrected together', singular) was silently dropped from INVENTORY.md's per-figure family list even though the data existed correctly in the underlying _stats.md file. Affected fig03 (5 of 9 families invisible: composition, layer, traces, presence, rxrr_trace) before the fig03_correlation fix above surfaced it. Fixed the regex to accept singular/plural.
claims.receipt: before fix: INVENTORY.md listed only 3 of 9 fig03 families; after fix: all 9 appear, matching fig03_unit_census/README.md's documented family list exactly

claims.text: fig04_laminar (4 files: fig04_V1_PFC_layers, supp_MT_FEF_layers, supp_TEO_PFC_layers, supp_V1_V4_layers) and fig05_area_by_band (4 files: all/sup/mid/deep layer variants) each reuse an identical family name across 4 separately-corrected batches of 10 tests apiece, rather than one jointly-corrected 40-test family. This is pre-existing code, not written this session. Recomputed both as joint 40-test Holm/BH corrections: for fig04_laminar every p is already >=0.25 (no result near significance either way, min raw p=0.25); for fig05_area_by_band the minimum raw p is 0.0137, still far above the joint-Holm threshold (0.05/40=0.00125) that would be needed to flip a conclusion. No current claim is affected, but the architecture is a latent false-positive risk if this analysis is re-run on more data -- flagged for the user to decide: rename to per-area-pair family names (honest, weaker), or refactor to one true joint family (stronger, more work). NOT fixed in this pass.
claims.receipt: python recompute: joint-40 Holm/BH on fig04's 40 rows changes zero significance calls (all already p_holm=1.0 per-file); joint-40 Holm/BH on fig05's 40 rows changes zero significance calls (smallest p=0.0137 needs <0.00125 to survive joint Holm, does not)

issues: fig04_laminar / fig05_area_by_band family-scope-vs-family-name mismatch not fixed -- needs a user decision on rename vs. joint-recompute before any future re-run of this analysis on updated data.
